hook:
How to stand out
at a tryout.
script: Here's how to stand out at a tryout without doing a single skill move. Show up early and introduce yourself. Ask for the ball and talk the whole time. Take your first touch away from pressure. And when you lose it, sprint back. Coaches remember who recovers.
caption:
How to stand out at a tryout (no skill moves needed) ⚡

1. Arrive early and introduce yourself to the coach
2. Talk and ask for the ball
3. Take your first touch away from pressure
4. Lose it? Sprint back right away

General advice, not any one club's checklist, but these are the habits coaches notice. Save this for tryout season and send it to a teammate.

Pathway 101: how Florida players move up.
